name: Responsive Srcset Generator
description: Generate responsive HTML srcset attributes and modern picture tags with breakpoint widths, DPR multipliers, and WebP/AVIF fallbacks.
search_intent: Generate responsive image srcset and picture HTML tags for web performance and SEO.

inputs.label: Base image path / filename
inputs.help: Relative or root-relative path to base image asset

inputs.label: Include WebP and AVIF modern picture sources

outputs.label: Generated HTML snippet with srcset & sizes
Generated <picture> element with modern format fallbacks

calculation: Parse comma-separated widths into a unique, sorted ascending array of positive integers, filtering out widths exceeding the original image width (unless explicitly specified). For each width w, compute proportional height h = round(w × originalHeight / originalWidth). Format srcset entries: '{name}-{w}w.{ext} {w}w'. Build HTML tag with width, height, srcset, sizes, alt, loading='lazy', decoding='async'. If modern formats enabled, build wrapping , , and fallback . CSS aspect ratio is simplified using greatest common divisor.
limitations: Generates HTML markup tags only; does not physically resize or export image files on disk.
Actual image asset resizing must be completed in your image optimization or CDN build pipeline (e.g. Sharp, Next.js Image, or Cloudinary).
Sizes rules should be verified against your CSS layout breakpoints.
